unchanged_gates: each robot one metre and one goal
scope_limits: no policy training or optimizer/GPU calls
no P2A learned-policy or 95-percent success credit
guard is conditional on delivered-estimate, speed, reaction and braking bounds; no unbounded localization/delay guarantee
synthetic head-on/crossing/stationary-bypass fixtures test geometry; native scripted Nav2 matrix tests actual pipeline and motion, not an exhaustive trajectory guarantee
native optimizer/GPU zero excludes synthetic CPU optimizer unit tests
three-robot short movement probes do not establish every target executability or learned exploration reliability
braking is a global stopping envelope, not a claim of instantaneous minimum centre deceleration during wheel-coupled turns
parameter readback establishes actual parameter values at paused release, not Gazebo actuator consumption
OPEN_LOOP smoother wall timer can run while physics paused; its configured acceleration is not a sim-time physical acceleration proof
angular finite source differences are sampled evidence only; arbitrary between-source dynamics remain outside empirical proof
next_gate: complete this preparation and present evidence for user acceptance; no new pilot or later checkpoint
offline_prerequisites: owner-known/shared-unknown static obstacle and fractional-grid regressions
native archived tb2 starvation and lethal-start counterfactual map replay
received odometry/accepted-goal reset, duplicates, conflicts and independent mutations
motion geometry head-on, crossing, parallel, stationary bypass, reverse and turning, fail-closed callback and launch topology tests
revision_reasons: parameter observer did not inherit worker-local canonical loopback UDP transport configuration; bind exact native-declared and Git-profile bytes before ROS startup; no dynamics/task/timeout relaxation

physical_response_criteria.consumer: independent stdlib consumer; no production geometry imports

event_families.A: final cmd_vel linear zero from meaningful preceding output; hard-zero response
event_families.B: actual native_cancel call attempt, corroborated by cancel response/CANCELED terminal; cancel→smoother→actuator total response, not a hard-zero latency proof

limits: interrupted stop intent/no fresh rest samples yields no evidence credit
report observed speed range; finite samples do not prove continuous upper bounds
no meaningful segments means stopping bound remains unverified

matrix_coverage.all_8_reset_episodes: all raw source integrity, speed/chord/angular bounds, every observed meaningful stop bound and strict closure must pass
matrix_coverage.each_robot_across_same_freeze_reset_matr: at least one credited meaningful A or B response per tb1/tb2/tb3 across the eight episodes
matrix_coverage.per_episode_missing_stop: report missing; do not relabel the strict per-episode physical-completeness result
matrix_coverage.independent_per_episode_motion_requireme: each robot received path >.05m and native accepted goal remains mandatory in every reset episode

capacity_scope: new explicit v2 engineering workload is not the historical P1C capacity workload; legacy source comparison remains unchanged for old inputs

angular_interface_criteria.raw_sources: task release through final physical boundary; exact int sec/nsec; all three own odometry streams
angular_interface_criteria.integrity: same-source dedupe only if complete raw payload identical; reject conflict, backwards source, frame change; first/last and internal source gaps<=0.10s
angular_interface_criteria.coverage: each robot at least one same-sign |wz|>=0.1 segment of >=3 consecutive fresh source samples; aggregate positive and negative; at least one robot both signs; stop/restart bidirectional coverage, not direct maximum-speed reversal proof
angular_interface_criteria.missing: FAIL, never impute samples or use terminal/deadline motion credit

angular_reset_criteria.coverage_scope: per-episode angular stimulus_coverage_passed/missing retained unchanged; only interface requires full coverage
angular_reset_criteria.comparison: finite sampled response evidence; not a continuous-time dynamics theorem
